Name: Ultimate Heal
Description: You create a sphere of healing energy and launch it towards a creature within range. They recover 1 Hit Point. This can only recover a creature to 1 Hit Point back from 0 Hit Points once per Long Rest. You can only heal a total of 10 Hit Points across all creatures per Long Rest this way.
At Higher Levels: At Higher Levels. This spell’s maximum healing increases to 20 when you reach 5th level, 40 at 11th level, and 80 at 17th level.
